g.text: Who: top 5 of 30 candidates, and the options naming a laureate

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f40

g.text: Awarded 12 Oct 2026: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, "for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation". No option named the pair:

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f40

g.text: Woodford's option (02) paired him with Galí and Gertler, and Hall's own option (28) described his work on consumption and labour-market fluctuations.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556773

g.text: Treatment: Preseen, 10 Oct 2026, one run, 14 context notes. 30 candidates nominated by a virtual committee (personas of the 2026 committee members on

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #556773

g.text: three language models) in the five leading fields of the field forecast; no "Other".
